descriptions.d27h_jetpack_direction_800ae338: Jetpack direction update: calls 0x800ae7d4 with mode 2 or 0, rotates (0,-0.5,-10) by the yaw and pitch from the rotation vector through 0x801f7538 and 0x801f740c, adds the gravity at 0x8045e788 minus ten times the velocity with its y forced non-positive, then resolves the Jetpack_directional setting and stores the vector at its +144.
